name: Mint
source:
"Welcome home, Master!"

Likes: Family, Master
Dislikes: Tomatoes
Hobbies: Going for walks
Special Ability: ???

She is a Cherubim: a half-animal, half-angel girl.

She has cat-like ears and tail, as well as angelic wings but does not have a halo. She has a complex about her tiny wings and usually wears toy wings to make up for it. She isn't good at using her angelic powers and is still an angel-in-training. She came down from Heaven to find a certain something but is unsuccessful and ends up collapsing on the side of the road. That's when you find and save her. Soon after, she begins to fondly call you master and affectionately waits at home for your return every day. 

She's kind of a brat who loves to play tricks. She wants to repay the favor of you saving her but it ends up being her that is taken care of instead. 

Voice Profile: A bit high-pitched but also calm and soothing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789650/NEKOMIMI_SWEET_HOUSEMATES_Vol_1]Steam[/url]]
